title: Scaling identity for integrals over blow-ups η_{x,r}(A) (change of variables (F1) behind Simon's proof of 1.6)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^N, r > 0, let A ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set and g : ℝ^N → ℝ an arbitrary function, and let η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) (SimonGMT blowUpMap x r), Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then ∫_{η_{x,r}(A)} g dHⁿ = r^{-n} ∫_A g(η_{x,r}(z)) dHⁿ(z), where ∫_S h dHⁿ denotes the Bochner integral of h against the restricted measure Hⁿ⌞S (Measure.restrict; S need not be measurable, and each side is 0 when its integrand is not integrable).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (x : Rn N) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ (A : Set (Rn N)) (g : Rn N → ℝ), ∫ y in blowUpMap x r '' A, g y ∂μHE[n] = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in A, g (blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n]
